title: Item
description: The unit of dispatch: an item of kind work or external (design part 3.2). Decisions have their own schema. In the files backend the body holds the sections Why, Done when, Plan and Notes; this schema covers the front matter. Derived fields (claimed, ready, blocked, stage, critical_path, lead_time) are never stored.

owner.description: The human accountable, if not the project owner.

opened_from.description: Signal, opportunity or decision IDs this was opened from.

needs.description: IDs that must be Done before this is ready.

touches.description: Path globs the item is expected to change.

resources.description: What this machine must have for the item to run here, such as gpu or browser (design part 13.4). An item that needs a resource the machine lacks is not dispatched here, and the orchestrator says why.

serial.description: Serial resources the item needs, such as gpu.

tier_hint.description: Optional override from the owner or the shaper.

changelog.description: One line for release notes, if the item changes public surface.

claim.description: Set by the claim commit on the executor's branch.
